chapter.verse: Tua khit, Galilee gam sungah Jesu zin kawikawi hi. Jew mite in Jesu thah theih nading thu zong uh ahih manin Judea gam sungah Jesu zin nuamlo hi.
Tu-in Jew mite' Buk Pawi hun tung kuanta hi.
Tua hangin a sanggamte in Jesu' kiangah, “Na nungzuite in zong na hih ding nasep teng a muhkhak nadingin hih tak nusia inla Judea gam va pai in.
A hang pen mi' theih ding a utte, na a semsim kuamah om lo hi. Hihte a sem na hihleh leitung' muhna ah kilaakkhia in,” ci uh hi.
(A hang pen a sanggamte nangawn in Jesu um lo uh hi.)
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Keima' hun tung nailo hi. Note' ading ahihleh na hun uh a tung den hi lel hi.
Leitung in note hong hua zolo hi. Ahi zongin a gamtatnate siahuai ci-in teci pang ka hih manin kei hong hua hi.
Pawi ah no va pai un. Kei ka hihleh keima' hun a cingin tung nailo ahih manin pawi ah kong pai kei ding hi.”
Tua teng a gen khit ciangin Galilee ah Jesu omsuak hi.
Ahih hangin a sanggamte a pai khit uh ciangin Jesu zong a langtang lo, a simthamin pawi ah va pai hi.
Pawi sungah Jew mite in, “Hua mipa koi ah om hiam?” ci-in Jesu zong uh hi.
Ama' vai-in mite kikal ah kiho kihuauna tampi om hi. Kimkhat in, “Amah mihoih khat hi,” ci uh a, a dangte in, “Hilo hi, mite lam a pialsakpa hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jew mite a kihtakna uh huhau-in a langtangin a pau ngam kuamah om lo hi.
Pawi hun a lang kiim pawlin biakinnpi sungah Jesu pai-in hilhcian kipan hi.
Tua hangin Jew mite in lamdang sa uh a, “Hih mipa laisin ngeilo pi-in pilna bangci neih theih ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Ka thu hilhcianna keima' a hilo-in kei hong sawlpa' a ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh Pasian' deih thu sep ding a ut nakleh ka thu hilhcianna Pasian' kiangpan hiam, kei' thu-a a paukhia ka hi hiam, cih theitel ding hi.
Ama' thu-a a paukhia mi pen ama' mimal minpha a zong ahi hi. Ahih hangin amah a sawlpa' minpha a zong mi pen a thumaan hi a, ama' sungah zuau thu om lo hi.
Note Moses in thukhun hong pia zo hilo ahi hiam? Hinapi kuamah in thukhun na zui tuankei uh hi. Tua kimlai, bang hangin kei hong that nuam na hi uh hiam?”
Mihonpi in, “Dawilawm nei na hi hi! Nang kua'n hong thah sawm zenzen ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Sepkhiat khat ka nei a, na vekun lamdang na sa uh hi.
Moses in note vun-atna thu hong piak ciangin (tua zong Moses' kiangpan hilo-in pupite' kiangpan hizaw a), Sabbath ni-in pasal vun-atna na zang uh hi.
Moses' thukhun a kipelh loh nading deihna tawh Sabbath ni-in pasal vun-atna kizang veve ahihleh Sabbath ni-in mi khat ka damsiangsak manin bang hangin kei' tungah heh na hi uh hiam?
Puatham mellesa tawh thukhen kei unla, thutang khinkhaina tawh thukhenzaw un.”
Tua hangin Jerusalem khuami kimkhat in, “Thah dinga a sawm uh hih mipa hilo hiam?
En dih un, amah in a langtangin thu gengen napi amaute in bangmah paupih lo uh hi. Hoh, uliante in hih mipa Khris ahihlam thei takpi uh ahi mai ding hiam?
Thukhat ah, hih mipa koi pan hong pai cih i thei hi. Khris ahihleh hong pai ciangin amah koi pan hong pai cih kuamah in thei lo ding hi,” ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin biakinnpi sungah thu a hilh laitak Jesu kiko a, “Kei nong thei uh a, koi pan hong pai cih zong nong thei uh hi. Ahih hangin kei pen kei' thu-a hong pai ka hikei hi. Kei hong sawlpa a thumaan hi a, note in amah na thei kei uh hi.
Kei ka hihleh ama' kiangpan hong pai ka hih manin amah ka thei a, amah in kei hong sawl hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu mat sawm uh a, ahih hangin ama' hunlenai tung nailo ahih manin ama' tungah khutnga kuamah om lo hi.
Ahi zongin mihon lakpan tampitak in Jesu um uh a, “Khris hong pai mahleh zong hih mipa zahin kihilna lim tam bawlzaw se ding ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu' vai-in hih thu teng mihonpi a kihuau ngeingai uh Pharisee-te in a zak uh ciangin siampi liante leh Pharisee-te in Jesu man dingin zum nasemte sawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Tawmvei sung note tawh kong om lai ding a, tua khit ciangin kei hong sawlpa' kiangah ka pai ta ding hi.
Kei nong zong ding uh a, nong mu kei ding uh hi. Ka omna ah zong nong pai theikei ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua hangin Jew mite khatlekhat kiho uh a, “I muh zawhloh dingin hih mipa koi ah pai sawm ahi hiam? Greek mite laka a kithehthangte kiang pai-in Greek mite thuhilh sawm ahi hiam?
‘Kei nong zong ding uh a, nong mu kei ding uh hi,’ a cih pen leh ‘Ka omna ah nong pai theikei ding uh hi,’ a cih pen bang a cihnopna hiding hiam?” ci uh hi.
Pawi hun a nunungpen ni leh a thupipen ni-in Jesu dingto-in kiko a,“A dangtak khatpeuh a om leh kei' kiangah hong pai henla tui dawn hen.
Kei hong um mi peuhmah Pasian' Laibu' hong gen bangin, ‘Ama' sungtawng pan nuntakna gunte luang ding hi,’” ci hi.
Hih pen Jesu in amah a um mite' ngah ding Kha a genna hi a, a hang pen amah minpha kipia nailo ahih manin Kha kingah nailo hi.
Mi kimkhat in hih thute a zak uh ciangin, “Hih pen Kamsangpa hi taktak hi,” ci uh hi.
A dangte in, “Hih pen Khris hi,” ci uh hi. Ahih hangin kimkhat in, “Khris, Galilee pana piang ding mah ahi hiam?
Pasian' Laibu in Khris pen David' suan sungpan leh David' pianna khua Bethlehem pan hong piang ding ci hilo ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua hi a, Jesu' vai-in mihonpi kikal ah lungsim kikakna om hi.
Kimkhat in Jesu man nuam uh a, ahih hangin ama' tungah khutnga kuamah om lo hi.
Tua ciangin zum nasemte zong siampi liante leh Pharisee-te' kiangah ciahkik uh a, tuate in, “Bang hangin amah hong kai lo na hi uh hiam?” ci uh hi.
Zum nasemte in, “Hih mipa banga thugen kuamah om ngeilo hi,” ci uh hi.
Pharisee-te in, “Note zong khem thuak ta na hi uh hiam?
Uliante leh Pharisee-te lakah amah a um khat beek om ahi hiam?
Hih thukhun a theilo mihonpi ahihleh samsiat a tuak uh ahi hi,” ci uh hi.
Amaute laka kihel, Jesu' kiangah zong a pai ngei, Nicodemus in amaute' kiangah,
“I thukhun in mi khatpeuh thugen hun pia masa lo pi, ama' hih teng zong thei lo pi-in thukhen ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Nang zong Galilee pan na hi hiam? Galilee pan kamsang piang ngeilo cih kantel inla thei ta in,” ci uh hi.
(Tua ciangin mimal kim a inn tek uhah ciah uh hi.
